description_en: Creates a dataset version. Currently, only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of versions is 20
description_zh: 创建数据集版本，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集，支持最大版本数为20
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-dataset-version --dataset-id dataworks-dataset:3pXXXb8o0ngr07njhps1 --url oss://test-oss-bucket/test_dir/ --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. Currently, only DataWorks datasets are supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID，当前仅支持DataWorks数据集
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the dataset version. The description can be up to 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据集版本描述,长度不超过1024
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The mount path. The path must start with /mnt/. Default value: /mnt/data
parameters.help_zh: 挂载路径，需要以/mnt/开头，默认为/mnt/data
parameters.name: mount_path

parameters.help_en:
The storage import configuration for the dataset. The required configuration varies depending on the storage type.
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
The values can be obtained from the response of the File Storage API DescribeFileSystems operation.

```JSON
{
  "fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // The file system ID.
  "fileSystemStorageType": "Performance", // The storage specification of the file system.
  "vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // The VPC ID of the mount target.
}
```

</details>
parameters.help_zh:
数据集的存储导入配置, 对于不同存储类型，需要的配置信息不同
<details>
<summary>NAS</summary>
取值可参考文件存储 API DescribeFileSystems 的返回信息

```JSON
{
  "fileSystemId": "3b6XXX89c9", // 文件系统ID
  "fileSystemStorageType": "Performance", // 文件系统的存储规格
  "vpcId": "vpc-uf66oxxxrqge1t2gson7s" // 挂载点的VPC ID
}
```

</details>
parameters.name: import_info

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the dataset version was created successfully
